ownership_excerpt: Founded by Jerry Logan in 1990. Remains a family owned construction supply distributor.
evidence_excerpt: Logan Contractors Supply, Inc. Categories Construction Equipment/Materials Associate. 4101 106th Street, Des Moines, IA 50322-7949. (515) 253-9048. Supplier of equipment, materials, rental and service to the construction industry in Iowa, Nebraska, Missouri and Kansas.
notes: Official site http://www.logancontractors.com/ returned an anti-bot challenge on 2026-10-01. AGC of Iowa and the Greater Des Moines Partnership both name Logan Contractors Supply and link that domain. Partnership street is 4101 NW 106th St., Urbandale, IA 50322-7949, with (515) 253-9048. AGC prints 4101 106th Street, Des Moines, IA 50322-7949 and the same phone. The phone is not labeled a mobile line. Partnership says the company remains a family owned construction supply distributor and uses Founded by Jerry Logan in 1990; that wording does not use owner, founder, co-founder, or managing member. AGC lists Nick Sinn as Vice President. A 2019 archive of the staff page lists Bruce Logan as President and Jeff Logan as Vice President; those titles were not used. No current published business email. Archived staff and order addresses were not copied.
